title: Built with care, made to grow
subtitle: Get to know the mission, the story and the values behind this project.

story.title: Why does this project exist?
story.p1: Every product starts with a simple question: how can we make this better? We started with the same question and set out to build a fast, secure and enjoyable experience.
story.p2: Today we keep improving it step by step — listening to feedback, sweating the details and shipping with care. This page is a small window into how we think and why we do what we do.

values.title: What we care about
values.item1Desc: We'd rather do fewer things exceptionally well — every detail has to earn its place.
values.item2Desc: Your data is a responsibility, not an asset. We protect it by design, not as an afterthought.
values.item3Desc: Fast pages, fast answers, fast iterations — respecting your time comes first.
values.item4Desc: Clear communication, honest roadmaps and no fine-print surprises.
